note: From January 2021, Producer Price Index home sales (HMPI) for product group 35.11 Electricity has changed designation to 35.14 Trade services of electricity.
From January 2021, Export Price Index (EXPI) and Import Price Index (IMPI) for product group 35.11 Electricity has changed designation to 35.11A Generation of electricity.

From January 2021, Price Index for Domestic Supply (ITPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI)  for product group 35.11 Electricity has changed designation to 35.11A_14 Generation and trade services of electricity.
2026-01-25: Regarding Price Index for Domestic Supply (ITPI), product group 32.1-4+9 (Other Manufactured Goods Except Medical Equipment) have been removed since the start of the time series.

This table will not be updated after 2029. As of January 2028, SPIN 2015 will be replaced by the European classification CPA 2.2. During 2028 and 2029, PPI will be published according to both CPA 2.2 and SPIN 2015.
